description: A React component implementing an interactive image lightbox with zoom, rotate, navigation, and close functionalities, including keyboard and mouse interactions.

classes.name: Lightbox
classes.description: A React class component providing a full-featured image lightbox with zoom, rotation, navigation, and close controls.

methods.name: getXY
methods.description: Calculates the x and y coordinates from mouse or touch events.

methods.name: getCurrentImage
methods.description: Returns the URL of the current image being displayed.

methods.name: resetZoom
methods.description: Resets zoom, position, and rotation to default.

methods.name: navigateImage
methods.description: Navigates to the next or previous image in the list.

methods.name: duringMove
methods.description: Handles the dragging/moving of the image.

methods.name: applyZoom
methods.description: Applies zoom in, out, or reset.

methods.name: applyRotate
methods.description: Rotates the image clockwise or counter-clockwise.

methods.name: shouldShowReset
methods.description: Determines if reset button should be shown.

methods.name: canvasClick
methods.description: Handles click on the image canvas, possibly closing the lightbox.

methods.name: keyboardNavigation
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for navigation and controls.
